svg.aria-label: ios-27 compatibility blocks for system libraries, Darwin and Apple UI
svg.text: each square = 1 declared representative function or contract, NOT the whole Apple API surface

g.title: libsystem_kernel / bsd; 42 targets; ceiling: conditional; selected xnu bsd calls can be translated, but guest ownership, cancellation, darwin errno, rights and file isolation need proof. only seven syscall probe selectors currently work in a tiny interpreter, not as linked libsystem exports.
libsystem_pthread; 21 targets; ceiling: conditional; darwin thread startup, tls, signals, cancellation and workqueues require more than linux pthread wrappers.
libdispatch / gdc; 20 targets; ceiling: conditional; dispatch object ownership and queues may be portable, but apple qos, workqueue and runloop integration need dedicated tests.
Swift runtime / ABI; 16 targets; ceiling: conditional; these are selected swift runtime contract families rather than exact mangled exports; true swift abi interoperability is absent.

CFNetwork / Network.framework; 12 targets; ceiling: conditional; the network path may use android transports through an isolated proxy; authentic apple policy and entitlement behavior is unproven.

libsystem_c / libc; 35 targets; ceiling: plausible; portable c functions could be implemented or safely forwarded after abi and guest address-space isolation; these are representative targets, not extracted iphone exports.
libobjc / objc runtime; 27 targets; ceiling: conditional; open objc runtimes provide a possible research starting point; apple objc abi and arm64e dispatch are not validated here.
CoreFoundation; 20 targets; ceiling: unknown; apple corefoundation binaries and exact cf ownership/event-loop behavior have not run; targets are representative public functions.
Foundation / classes; 16 targets; ceiling: unknown; selected class contracts, not every foundation method or real symbols. apple foundation loading has not been demonstrated.
Foundation / classes / NSString text operations: unimplemented
Foundation / classes / NSDate and timers: unimplemented
libdyld / dynamic loading; 12 targets; ceiling: conditional; mapped native fixtures do not export a compatible libdyld ABI to unmodified apple programs.
Security / keychain; 12 targets; ceiling: unknown; keychain, signing, attestation and entitlements rely on an apple-specific trust model that the android host does not provide.
bsd syscall boundary; 17 targets; ceiling: conditional; a narrow interpreter responds to six identity calls plus a virtual exit, not general darwin syscalls from native processes.
